# Expose check, build, spec and trace as MCP tools in the same binary
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #349, sha256:aa731171d70019173f68361b11564d5db771cbbce689626ca37aab7a917eae8c). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (the same CLI binary; check, build, spec and trace)
- **Source:** .mob/records/platform-options/standalone-recommendation-2026-11-08.md (Proposed stories (PM), card 349) and the product owner's decisions of 2026-11-08 (stand-alone platform report: `avowry mcp` in the same binary; file card 344 to card 349 as Draft; Ari's execution constraint applied). Survey 2026-11-08 does not mention MCP.
- **Depends on:** card 344 and card 360 (the spec tool needs a runner that evaluates specs without a target toolchain)
- **Story:** As Ari, I want check, build, spec and trace as MCP tools in the same binary, so that I get structured diagnostics with location and fix.
- **Consumer value:** Ari gets structured diagnostics with location and fix through MCP; we see it when a source-error tool reply carries code, line and next action.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [E][O] source error as a tool
     Given a source error, and Ari usually runs in a Linux container or sandbox and often cannot run code at all
     When called as an MCP tool
     Then the reply carries code, line and next action
  2. Scenario: [I][M] four tools in the same binary
     Given the native binary from card 344
     When Ari lists MCP tools
     Then check, build, spec and trace are tools of that binary
  3. Scenario: [Z][S] clean source
     Given source that checks clean
     When check is called as a tool
     Then the reply has no error code and names no line as a fault
  Letters that do not apply: [B] no size or count boundary is specified; first-failing-phase compilation (coarse editor feedback) is a current compiler fact, not a new boundary this card sets.
- **Not in this card:** a language server (parked until card 345 has run); a Wasm toolchain build; card 345–card 348; publishing; a registry; a UI; other targets.
- **Unknowns:** demand evidence is weak (the survey does not mention MCP); JSON-RPC is the only new dependency named (hand-rolled to stay AOT-friendly); compilation stops at the first failing phase. The CLI has no spec runner today (specs are xUnit via `dotnet test`). A spike is allowed only once card 349 is the top story.
- **Size:** M
